def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate the 8-bit value x left by k bits, wrapping the high bits to the low end."""
    pre 0 <= k and k < 8
    post out <= 255
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(18, 0) == 18
    ex rotl8(18, 4) == 33
    low = (x & (255 >> k)) << k
    high = x >> 1 >> (7 - k)
    return low | high
